issues.text: Lines 1-14774 of docs/requirements.yaml changed between ISS-0092 step 02c (sha256 04a490e3…) and this step (c58ccad4…), with the same line count: REQ-103's status line is now `status: in_progress` (pending at the tag), ORCH's move at the start of M0DOCS WF-02 (CLAUDE.md, ORCH's closed list). Not my edit; this step's proof that only REQ-110 changed is the hash of lines 1-14774 before and after this step (c58ccad4… both).

The design's own rule (section 7, item 3) is stricter than criterion 6 in one point: it also forbids the signs & | ; < > ` $ ( ) and a line end inside the scripts before `npm run traces`. Criterion 6 forbids the joiners of `check`, any token that holds `>`, `tee`, and any first token other than prettier or eslint, which already catches `X=1 eslint .`, `| tee x` and a redirect (fact 17), but it does not forbid, for example, a `$` or `(` inside a script. decisions/0120 О2 asks only for the eight options, so the criterion does not take the design's extra signs; the design gate may judge whether the extra signs are a check stricter than its criterion (AP-159 (3)).

eslint 10.11.0's table has options I did not classify by a measurement: --flag (feature flags) and --plugin load code; --stats and --concurrency change the run. None names a file to write by its name or type, and the design lists them neither way. If a future pinned version adds a writing option, criterion 6 names the versions so the list is re-read in that work.
